name: Gophirith the Mirror Master
storyline:
Gophirith the Mirror Master needs your help!
Can you stack and arrange the falling mirrors so that the light beams will reflect off as many as possible? Fill up your light gauge, then unleash it to rack up huge combos!
summary: Watch your score climb higher and higher in the arcade mode or clean the screen of mirrors in puzzle mode in this exciting falling block puzzle loosely inspired by the Fantasy adventure Gophirith of the Mountains.
